notes.title: Update 0.2.6.0
notes.notes:
A new update for testers is here!

[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Critical Hit in Combat System
[*] Added VO for Castle Guard when it gets hit
[*] Added VO for Castle Guard when dies
[*] Added initial support for Quests and Enciclopedia menu tabs
[*] Added Armor Set Bonus feature
[/list]

[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Switched to Unity 2020.3
[*] Switched Render Pipeline to URP
[*] Changed Castle Guard's moveset and stats
[*] Changed Chain's base stats
[*] Changed damage inflict timing on Attack card
[*] Added stipple fade effect on walls
[*] Tuned post processing effects
[*] Changed camera position in battle scene
[*] Changed pause menu
[*] Fixed some names
[/list]

[h2]Removed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed character outline when view obstructed
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Controller no longer vibrate when starting a fight while opening a door
[*] The controller can now be used in main menu
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] It's possible to equip the same ability under certain circumstances
[*] The controller cannot be used in Exit sub menu
[*] Some Chain animations are missing in battle
[*] Some Castle Guard are missing in both battle and overworld
[*] The enemy's AI cannot see Chain in some directions while patroling
[*] Enemy's AI cannot move in the scene
[*] Castle's Corridor is partially missing
[*] It's impossible to return to main menu
[/list]

[/list]

We can't wait to share more very soon!
